items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee J.C. Higginbotham does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Lucille is made by the Interviewer, who states 'Jay, you should know that' regarding Louis Armstrong meeting Lucille. There is no evidence in the text that J.C. Higginbotham has a personal relationship with Luci

ctx.x: Sure. They didn't have nothing to offer.
Leslie Uggams, I met her. She may not remember me but I met her. She was dancing at that club downtown... That's where Louis Armstrong first met Lucille. Jay, you should know that.
I'm the one that introduced them...
